title: Serbia's strongman leader Vucic concedes defeat to student-led movement in seismic political shift
snippet: It was a seismic political shift in the Balkan country where Vucic, who had been endorsed by Russian President Vladimir Putin and who denounced the student movement as a foreign-led attempt to unseat him, led with virtually absolute power for 14 years.

title: Vucic concedes defeat in Serbia's parliamentary election
snippet: Aleksandar Vucic, who denounced the oppositional student movement as a foreign-led attempt to unseat him, led with virtually absolute power for 14 years.
